g = app.actions.run('dr.get')
print('DR_GET', g)
assert g['camera'] and g['articulated'] and not g['drawn'] and g['seed'] == 1 and g['reset_draws'], g
assert not g['render']['on'] and not g['physics']['on'] and g['params'] == {}, g
assert {'link_mass', 'joint_damping', 'joint_armature'} <= set(g['keys']) and 'gravity_z' not in g['keys'], g['keys']

import builtins
import numpy as np
run, color = app.actions.run, builtins.dr_color
c0 = color('c0')
g = run('dr.set', seed=1, render={'on': True, 'color': 0.4, 'light_intensity': 0.5, 'ambient': 0.5})
assert g['drawn'] and g['render']['on'] and abs(g['render']['color'] - 0.4) < 1e-6 and g['seed'] == 1, g
c1 = color('c1')
assert run('dr.sample') == {'seed': 2}
c2 = color('c2')
assert run('dr.sample', seed=1) == {'seed': 1}
c1b = color('c1b')
d01 = float(np.abs(c1.astype(np.float64) - c0).mean())
d12 = float(np.abs(c2.astype(np.float64) - c1).mean())
print('DR_RENDER', c0.dtype, c0.shape, d01, d12, np.array_equal(c1, c1b))
assert not np.array_equal(c1, c0) and not np.array_equal(c2, c1) and np.array_equal(c1, c1b), (d01, d12)
g = run('dr.set', render={'on': False})
assert not g['drawn'] and not g['render']['on'], g
assert np.array_equal(color('c0b'), c0)

g = app.actions.run('dr.set', seed=5, physics={'on': True, 'mass': [0.9, 1.1], 'armature': [0.0, 0.001], 'gravity': [-2.0, -1.0]})
print('DR_PHYSICS', g['physics'])
assert g['drawn'] and g['physics']['on'] and g['physics']['gravity'] == [-2.0, -1.0], g

g = app.actions.run('dr.set', physics={'on': False}, reset_draws=True)

import builtins
builtins.dr_qa = builtins.dr_q()
assert abs(builtins.dr_imu() - 9.81) < 0.3, builtins.dr_imu()

p = g['params']['drive_stiffness']

import builtins
g = app.actions.run('dr.set', seed=11, render={'on': True, 'color': 0.2, 'roughness': 0.3}, physics={'on': True, 'gravity': [-0.5, 0.5]}, params={'joint_damping': {'on': True, 'range': [0.5, 1.5]}})
assert g['drawn'] and g['seed'] == 11, g
builtins.dr_saved = g

import builtins
g = app.actions.run('dr.get')
print('DR_REOPEN', g)
assert g == builtins.dr_saved, (g, builtins.dr_saved)

import time
end = time.monotonic() + 8.5
while time.monotonic() < end:
    app.update(True)

import builtins
run, fails = app.actions.run, builtins.dr_fails
fails('dr.set', 'the color jitter cannot be negative', render={'color': -0.1})
fails('dr.set', 'the mass range is [lo, hi] with 0 < lo <= hi', physics={'mass': [0.0, 1.0]})
fails('dr.set', 'the gravity range is [lo, hi] with lo <= hi', physics={'gravity': [1.0, -1.0]})
fails('dr.set', "no parameter 'gravity_z' takes a range", params={'gravity_z': {'on': True}})
assert run('dr.get')['seed'] == 11
g = run('dr.set', render={'on': False}, physics={'on': False}, params={'joint_damping': {'on': False}})
assert not g['drawn'], g
fails('dr.sample', 'disabled')

import builtins
run, fails = app.actions.run, builtins.dr_fails
run('scene.spawn', kind='box', pose={'pos': [0.0, 0.0, 0.25], 'quat': [1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0]})
g = run('dr.get')
assert not g['camera'] and not g['articulated'] and not g['drawn'] and g['seed'] == 1, g
fails('dr.set', 'needs a camera sensor', render={'on': True})
fails('dr.set', 'needs an articulated body', physics={'on': True})
